dimensions.evidenceA: Forty thousand stalls are reported in Kings.
dimensions.evidenceB: Four thousand stalls are reported in Chronicles.
dimensions.label: Reported number

evidence.observation: Kings says Solomon had forty thousand stalls of horses for his chariots.
Chronicles says Solomon had four thousand stalls for horses and chariots.

record.tension: The parallel reign summaries give different numbers for Solomon’s horse stalls.
record.title: How many horse stalls does Solomon have?
